newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ex-Communist leader Marchais feeling better.
newsitem.headline: French ex-Communist leader Marchais feeling better.

text.p: Veteran former French Communist party leader Georges Marchais, 76, who was taken to hospital overnight suffering from a recurring heart ailment, was still in hospital on Thursday but feeling better, party officials said.
Marchais had left the intensive care unit, they said, and recevied a visit from Robert Hue, who succeeded Marchais as party leader in 1993, the spokesman added.

A hardliner who approved Soviet intervention in Afghanistan in 1979, Marchais led France's once-powerful Communist party, long one of Moscow's staunchest allies in Western Europe, from 1972 until he handed over to Hue three years ago.
Marchais has had heart attacks in the past.
